description: Diagram Render. Render a previously saved diagram by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports ?format= and ?query= overrides.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

format.description: Override output format. Allowed values: svg, png, jpeg, pdf. Default: "svg".

id.description: The diagram ID returned in the X-Diagram-Render-URL header when saving a diagram. Format: cq-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.

share.description: Set share=true to persist the config and receive JSON instead of an image: { id, render_url, view_url, embed_url, expires_in }. Free plan: 3-day expiry with watermark. Paid plan: 6-month expiry, no branding. Default: false.

name: diagram_render
title: Diagram Render
